selection_basis: Known cut1 alphabet and seven length shortages are exposed; development selection targets them. Fresh reserves are assigned by work/manuscript identity before body acquisition and are never searched for missing units.

Latin.scope: 14th-century political prose, NONMEDICAL Latin length sensitivity; one continuous work; not herbal-register replacement

Italian.scope: new cantica; shared author and larger work with old Inferno; NOT author/work-independent replication

Czech.scope: 14th-century dramatic fragment; diplomatic spelling supplement only; not a long generation source; no modernization or supplied expansions

Occitan.scope: 13th-century narrative verse; broader Old Occitan, NOT independent Old Gascon legal-register qualification

AbbreviatedLatin.scope: unread manuscripts selected by pre-existing genre/date metadata; medical/scholastic/literary/ecclesiastical strata kept; 15th-century supplements reported separately

Occitan.status: source body acquisition pending; do not substitute translation

prohibited: all cut1 calibration/reserve text and parallel editions as new development
reserve body reads, unit counts, fitting, or scoring

old_sources: Cut1 development may remain separately identified. No old source file, map, result, or policy is overwritten. New development is not activated for claim generation.
